physical_write_done_handshake.ownership: Nash holds identity until matching completion is accepted; original source has no ready

W2_model_extension.representation: 35-bit source tag plus explicit4-bit generation sideband; do not silently overwrite original tag. Packed39 is equivalent only with priced source/endpoint adapter.

allocation.generation_owner: source-bound allocator of the exact PC transaction slot; compact bridge allocator when adapter exists. Caller software lease64 is not substituted as wire generation.
allocation.generation_reset: coordinated all-endpoint/backend/CDC drain or flush; never local valid/counter clear alone
allocation.original_tag_owner: actual accepted requester; W2 retains all32 bits
allocation.wrap: modulo16 only after source all-copies including matched reverse CDC quiescence receipt; price wait. No monotonically increasing4-bit run cap; no generation1 assumption

client_mapping.NC5: standalone PC source default, not proof of generic production client enrollment
client_mapping.NC6: full wrapper exists; source fixture client5 is KV
client_mapping.required: Popper/root bind actual accepted C0/KV/directory caller classes, arbitration and SM/PC mapping. Do not take occupied KV index5 as free issuer. Nash price NC5 first; NC6 joins full bridge price before whole-design claim.

compact_bridge.namespace: physical PC lane or proven pre-CDC reversible mapping; original tag32 restored from private context

exact_table.SM_and_home_owner: retain in mapped bridge context; a per-PC completion count/table alone cannot invent SM, home or lease
exact_table.held: stable completion valid/tag/gen/direction until ready; capture/backpressure ports and cells owned/priced by Nash
exact_table.match: exact live reserved {PC,client,slot,originaltag32,gen4,direction}; read only matches read, write completion only write; no unmatched/duplicate/stale release
exact_table.simultaneous_update: joint allocation/read-return/write-completion decision from old registered live state; no hidden double release or same-edge alias reuse
exact_table.sticky_fault: wrong client, stale generation, absent live row, duplicate, wrong direction or reset-epoch mismatch; fault suppresses matching grant/release

full_stream_gate.small_C0: parameterized fixture only, not full design admission

owner: Nash: model/source-interface only, default-off, no RTL/build admission

responsibilities.Euclid_Goodall_Dewey: actual requester/visibility/consumer/drain receipts; no synthetic whole-stream qualification
responsibilities.Nash: per-PC exact table, generation echo and held-ready port extension, cells/selectors/protection/latency/model tests
responsibilities.Popper: whole bridge mapping/directory/arbitration and composed calendar/physical cost

write_visibility.KV_adapter: logical WRITE_REQ ready only after matching physical write completion; retain page/address/originaltag/epoch match through RMW. Existing adapter lacks generation echo.
write_visibility.PC_request_ready: request accepted into service only; not HBM visible
write_visibility.RF: both copy write accepts -> one identity-bearing common ACK -> metadata fence visible -> consumer -> child reverse -> parent reverse -> reverse CDC -> credit/context release
write_visibility.backend_wr_done: must originate from actual accepted backend write and source-qualified visibility/order condition; tag+gen echoed exactly
write_visibility.c_wr_done: held exact write-completion acceptance; not proof of RF visibility/consumer retirement
